# Vendored Browser Dependencies

These pinned browser builds keep the standalone Agentic System page compatible with restrictive CSP policies and offline development.

- `d3-7.9.0.min.js`: D3.js 7.9.0, ISC license, https://github.com/d3/d3
- `dagre-0.8.5.min.js`: Dagre 0.8.5, MIT license, https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre
- `lucide-0.468.0.min.js`: Lucide 0.468.0, ISC license, https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

Update the pinned version in the filename and this manifest together.
